articles.title: Dallas Market Center Launches AI Training Program for Independent Retailers
articles.summary: Dallas Market Center, the 5 million-square-foot B2B trading hub and wholesale marketplace northwest of downtown Dallas, just introduced an AI training program for a sizable chunk of its customer base: independent retailers. The market center said its Retail Ready program is the first B2B marketplace to create an AI education program for independent retailers. …

articles.title: Dallas’ Southwest Airlines Launches ChatGPT Plugin to Help Customers Find Flights
articles.summary: Dallas-based Southwest Airlines said it just became the first U.S. airline to incorporate flight-shopping capabilities directly into ChatGPT, one of the world’s most popular AI tools. Southwest’s ChatGPT plugin, which went live Tuesday, lets users search destinations and compare dates, times and fares in a ChatGPT conversation.…

articles.title: Dallas Startup UpSmith Raises $10M Series A to Put AI to Work for Home-Services Providers
articles.summary: Dallas-based UpSmith raised a $10 million Series A round to expand its engineering and sales teams and ramp up partnerships. The startup’s AI platform helps home-services contractors find and act on otherwise missed revenue opportunities. SemperVirens led the round. Other investors include Hannah Grey Ventures, Asymmetric Capital Partners, CIV, Synetro Group, the Tim Tebow-affiliated WaterStone Impact Fund, former OpenAI executive Colin Evans of Sandwith Ventures, Deason Capital Services and OpenGov co-founder Zachary Bookman. …

articles.title: Patented: Lennox’s Machine-Learning Thermostat Scheduling and 105 More Inventions Across North Texas
articles.summary: Richardson-based Lennox Industries, a subsidiary of Lennox International (NYSE: LII), has patented a heating, ventilation and air conditioning control device. The patent application describes a device that uses machine learning to predict when a building is occupied and adjust its schedule based on how aggressively the user wants to save energy.…

articles.title: Texas agency sues to stop release of data center records that it says could aid terrorists
articles.summary: A lawsuit will test whether Texas officials can withhold data center location details under the state Homeland Security Act.

articles.title: Cisco broadens agentic features in Webex collaboration platform
articles.summary: Cisco Systems Inc. today detailed a broad expansion of its Webex collaboration portfolio that brings artificial intelligence agents into team conversations, connects office technology with workplace management and enables customer-service agents to continue working after an interaction ends. Introduced at WebexOne in Austin, Texas, the updates extend Cisco’s strategy of integrating people, AI agents and […]
